title: Derivative of the moment gap at zero
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q,\rho\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The hypercontractive moment gap, as a function of $t$, is differentiable at $t=0$, with derivative
\[pq(1-\rho)\,\mathbb E_{x\in\Omega}X(x).\]
